resources.string: Covers feed posts from accounts you don\'t follow
Reads the screen in Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube so it can cover posts and videos you did not choose to see. Nothing is sent anywhere: the app has no internet permission.
FocusTube needs accessibility access to read what is on screen. Turn it on under Installed apps.
Off means the app is not touched at all. Instagram covers the app and instagram.com in Chrome.
While locked, nothing can be switched off. You can still switch more on, and you can extend the lock.
Locked — this cannot be turned off yet
This is a promise the app makes to you, not a security measure: Android\'s own accessibility switch is always there.
Posts from accounts you don\'t follow
LinkedIn: posts your network only reacted to
Off, you still see what your connections liked or commented on.
The search bar stays; only what the grid suggests is covered.
Covers the Shorts player and makes the Shorts tab untappable.
Covers the Reels player and makes the Reels tab untappable.
LinkedIn: \"People you may know\" and similar cards

This app has no internet permission, so it cannot send anything anywhere. It only receives screen content from Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube — the system enforces that list. Nothing is stored except the switches above.
